bio: The name of this French restaurant denotes respect for the farmers, fishermen, and potters who support the chef through their work. Prix fixe offerings use Japanese and French ingredients, refined through the skills the chef honed in Paris. Amuse-bouche items include tartare of wagyu beef and wafer cake of pickled daikon radish; in homage to Japanese tradition, the meal ends with a rice dish. Main dishes incorporate the classics, with duck wrapped in pie pastry as the standard....
